payload.longDescription: 通过产品照片和您的创意简报创建落地页板块图片和用户生成内容视频。选择格式并在交互式卡片中批准每次生成，然后下载您的结果。连接您的UGCBuilder账户即可开始。

payload.name: Studio by Memes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create on-brand marketing creative without leaving the conversation. Studio by Memes connects your Memes.ai Studio account so you can use your saved brand kits to generate meme ads, images, carousels, storyboards and short videos, check progress, and get finished media with download links, saved to your Studio Gallery. With separate permission, manage brand kits and saved media, and preview, schedule and publish approved posts to your connected social accounts. Generation uses your existing Studio plan and credits; every publish requires an approved preview.
payload.longDescription: 在不离开对话界面的情况下创建符合品牌调性的营销创意。Studio by Memes连接你的Memes.ai Studio账户，即可使用已保存的品牌套件生成表情包广告、图片、轮播图、分镜脚本和短视频，查看进度并获取包含下载链接的成品媒体，所有内容都会保存至你的Studio画廊。通过独立权限管理品牌套件和已保存媒体，预览、安排并发布已审批的帖子至已连接的社交账号。生成内容会消耗现有Studio计划的配额和积分；每次发布都需要经过审批的预览版本。

payload.name: appdesigns
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
appdesigns turns your app's screenshots into a store-ready screenshot set for the App Store or Google Play, then opens it as a project you can keep editing.

Attach 1 to 6 screenshots of your app and say which store they are for. ChatGPT writes a short screen name and a headline for each screen from what it shows, and appdesigns puts every screenshot in a real device frame (iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo, Pixel or Galaxy) on a background, at the exact canvas size the store asks for, such as 1320 x 2868 for iPhone or 1080 x 1920 for Google Play.

You get a link that opens the set in the appdesigns editor. Sign in there to save it to your library, change any text, colour, device or layout, and export PNGs at store size, ready to upload to App Store Connect or the Play Console.

In Codex and other coding agents, appdesigns can also capture the screenshots for you: the agent plans the screens from your app's code, checks the demo data with you, captures each screen in the iOS Simulator, Android emulator or a browser, and hands over the same editable set.

Screenshots are stored privately and deleted once you save the set, or after 72 hours if you never open it. No account is needed until you choose to save.
payload.longDescription:
appdesigns将您的应用截图转化为适用于App Store或Google Play的商店就绪截图集，然后以可继续编辑的项目形式打开。

上传1到6张应用截图并说明对应的应用商店。
ChatGPT会根据屏幕内容为每张截图生成简短的屏幕名称和标题，appdesigns将每张截图放入真实设备框架（iPhone、iPad、iPhone Duo、Pixel或Galaxy）中，使用商店要求的精确画布尺寸（如iPhone的1320 x 2868或Google Play的1080 x 1920）置于背景上。

您将获得一个可打开截图集的链接。
在appdesigns编辑器中登录后，可将截图集保存到资料库，修改任何文字、颜色、设备或布局，并导出符合商店尺寸的PNG文件，即可上传至App Store Connect或Play Console。

在Codex和其他编码代理中，appdesigns还可为您自动截屏：代理会根据应用代码规划屏幕布局，与您核对演示数据，通过iOS模拟器、安卓模拟器或浏览器捕获每张屏幕，并交付相同的可编辑截图集。

截图以私密方式存储，保存截图集后即被删除，或在未打开的情况下保留72小时。
除非选择保存，否则无需账户。

payload.name: Dare
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create images, video clips and speech using your connected Dare account. Inspect available models, estimate credit use, reuse media from your library, analyze videos, transcribe speech, align scripts and add captions. Generation and media processing use your account's existing credits. Multi-clip assembly, motion graphics and audio mixing require a client with command-line media tools; these editing operations are not hosted by this integration.
payload.longDescription:
通过已连接的Dare账户创建图像、视频片段和语音。
查看可用模型，估算信用消耗，复用素材库中的媒体内容，分析视频，转录语音，对齐剧本并添加字幕。
生成和媒体处理会消耗您账户的现有信用额度。
多片段合成、动态图形和音频混音需要具备命令行媒体工具的客户端；这些编辑操作未通过此集成方案提供。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate images and video, Generate speech, Analyze and caption media, Reuse library media

payload.name: Aqueduct
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create procedural textures and PBR materials in Aqueduct through ChatGPT. Connect your Aqueduct account to browse texture graphs, edit materials, and download PNG, JPG, or TGA textures. Agentic project edits sync live to the Aqueduct editor.
payload.longDescription:
通过ChatGPT在Aqueduct中创建程序化纹理和PBR材质。
连接您的Aqueduct账户以浏览纹理图、编辑材质并下载PNG、JPG或TGA纹理。
代理项目编辑会实时同步到Aqueduct编辑器。

payload.name: Sandcastles
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sandcastles helps short-form video creators research what's working across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram. Discover top channels, analyze winning formats and hooks, recap watchlists, and turn insights into your next video.
payload.longDescription:
Sandcastles帮助短视频创作者在YouTube、TikTok和Instagram上研究哪些内容有效。
发现顶级频道，分析成功的内容格式和吸引点，回顾观看列表，并将洞察转化为您的下一支视频。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Channel discovery and watchlist management, Video and format analysis, Hook and topic research, Automation rules for library curation

payload.name: AVSBL Website Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AVSBL account to create and edit saved website drafts through ChatGPT. Describe your business and ask for pages, sections, text, colours, buttons, or image placement. ChatGPT uses AVSBL’s existing builder options, and you can continue editing in AVSBL. The plugin can read your draft and approved project images, import images you choose to attach, and save supported draft changes. It cannot publish a website; you review and publish manually in AVSBL. An AVSBL account with website access is required.
payload.longDescription: 连接您的AVSBL账户，通过ChatGPT创建和编辑保存的网站草稿。描述您的业务并请求页面、板块、文字、颜色、按钮或图片布局。ChatGPT使用AVSBL现有的构建工具选项，您可以在AVSBL中继续编辑。该插件可读取您的草稿和已批准项目图片，导入您选择附加的图片，并保存支持的草稿修改。它无法直接发布网站；您需在AVSBL中手动审核并发布。需要拥有网站访问权限的AVSBL账户。

payload.name: Bildy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and edit images and videos from a conversation with Bildy. Discover available models, generate from a prompt or supplied image, and get a download link when the job finishes. Bildy also offers tools to trim clips, extract frames, and combine media. Sign in to your Bildy account to use the tools. Prompts and supplied media are processed under Bildy's Privacy Policy.
payload.longDescription: 通过与Bildy的对话创建和编辑图像及视频。探索可用模型，根据提示或提供的图像生成内容，并在任务完成后获取下载链接。Bildy还提供剪辑片段、提取帧和合并媒体的工具。登录Bildy账户以使用这些工具。提示内容和提供的媒体将根据Bildy的隐私政策进行处理。

payload.name: Kids Book Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create something special for story time with your child.

Kids Book Maker helps parents and other adults turn their ideas into narrated picture books for their children. Make a bedtime story, invent an adventure around your child’s favorite animal, or turn one of their drawings into the star of a book.

Tell the app what your child enjoys and how old they are. Choose a language and illustration style, or let the app choose the details. Each book includes an illustrated cover, a picture on every page, spoken narration, and captions you can read together.

Ideas for your next story:

- A gentle bedtime adventure about friendship or sharing
- A story starring a character from your child’s drawing
- A reassuring tale about starting kindergarten or trying something new
- A picture book in your family’s language
- A playful adventure featuring pictures you provide

This app is for adults creating entertainment for their children. You create and review the book, then choose how to share it with your child.

Books normally have 8 to 12 pages, including the cover, and use a wide landscape format. Illustrations use the cover as a reference to help keep characters consistent, though generated pictures can vary between pages.

Books are created as unlisted, with a claim link. They are not publicly listed, but anyone with the link can watch and claim an unclaimed book to their Scrimba profile. To make a book private, sign in, claim it, and change its privacy setting to Private.

Powered by Scrimba.
payload.longDescription:
为与孩子共度的阅读时光创造特别的回忆

Kids Book Maker帮助家长和其他成年人将其创意转化为儿童有声绘本。创作睡前故事，围绕孩子最喜欢的动物设计冒险，或将其一幅画作转化为书籍的主角。

告诉应用孩子喜欢什么以及他们的年龄。选择语言和插图风格，或让应用自动选择细节。每本绘本包含封面插图、每页配图、语音旁白，以及可供共同阅读的文字说明。

下个故事的创作灵感

- 关于友谊或分享的温馨睡前冒险故事
- 以孩子画作角色为主角的故事
- 安抚孩子情绪的幼儿园入学故事
- 用家庭语言创作的绘本
- 采用您提供的图片展开的趣味冒险

本应用专为成人创作儿童内容设计。您需要完成书籍创作与审核，然后选择分享方式给您的孩子。

书籍通常包含8到12页（含封面），采用横向版式。插图以封面为参考确保角色一致性，但不同页面的生成图片可能有所差异。

书籍创建时为未公开状态，并附带一个认领链接。这些书籍不会被公开列出，但任何持有该链接的人都可以观看并将其认领至自己的Scrimba个人资料。如需将书籍设为私有，需登录账号、完成认领后，将隐私设置更改为「私有」。

由Scrimba提供支持。

payload.name: QuickStage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Add virtual furniture and decor to real-estate listing photos. Choose a furnishing style and retrieve a preview and downloadable result in supported hosts. QuickStage works from a photo of the real space; it does not create a room from text alone. Supported exterior photos use Curb Appeal.

Start with an empty room for the best results. Furnished photos can still be staged, but existing furnishings may change. Before generation, review the selected photo, room type, style and one-credit use with your agent. Separate angles can produce different furniture.

Ask for a QuickFix in plain language: “Make the added sofa smaller” or “Move the added plant away from the doorway.” For a completed photo staged in this connected chat app, your agent identifies the result and confirms one QuickFix, with zero staging credits. No special prompt or job number is needed when the photo is clear from the conversation. Corrections use the saved original photo and style; other generated details can change. Photos staged on the website receive corrections there.

Requires a verified QuickStage account with available eligible allowance. Each confirmed staging request uses one staging credit; corrections use the separate shared QuickFix balance. Eligible allowances are shared with the website. QuickStage access is separate from ChatGPT access. Check account status for the allowance supported by this integration.

Compare each generated image with the original and disclose virtual staging as required by your listing rules. QuickStage does not guarantee perfect image accuracy, certify MLS compliance or publish listings.
payload.longDescription:
为房产挂牌照片添加虚拟家具和装饰。
选择装修风格后，可在支持的平台获取预览图和可下载结果。
QuickStage基于真实空间的照片进行虚拟装修；它无法仅凭文字创建房间。
支持的外景照片会使用门面吸引力功能。

建议以空房间照片获得最佳效果。
带家具的照片仍可进行虚拟装修，但现有家具可能会有所调整。
生成前请与您的经纪人确认选定照片、房间类型、风格及单次使用额度。
不同角度的拍摄可能呈现不同的家具布置。

用自然语言提出快速修复需求："把添加的沙发调小"或"把添加的植物挪离门口"。在该连接应用中完成装修的图片，您的经纪人将识别结果并确认一次快速修复，不消耗虚拟装修积分。
当照片已从对话中清除时，无需特殊提示或工单编号。
修正操作会保留原始照片和风格；其他生成细节可能发生变化。
网站端装修的图片需在网站端进行修正。

需要拥有可用额度的已验证QuickStage账户。
每个确认的装修请求会消耗一个虚拟装修积分；修正操作使用独立共享的快速修复额度。
符合条件的额度也适用于网站端。
QuickStage访问权限与ChatGPT访问权限相互独立。
请查看账户状态以确认本集成支持的额度。

根据挂牌规则要求，需将生成的每张图片与原图对比并披露虚拟装修信息。
QuickStage不保证图像完全准确，不认证MLS合规性也不发布挂牌信息。

payload.name: SuperCool
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SuperCool is an AI agent that makes finished work from a plain-language request. Connect your SuperCool account and ask for what you need in ChatGPT: your agent plans it, makes it in your SuperCool account, and sends the results back into the conversation as images, audio, playable video and links.

With SuperCool, you can:

• Make video ads, product videos, social shorts and explainers, with music, voiceover and captions.

• Create product photos, image ads and branded visuals in any style, from a description or your own photos.

• Make talking-head videos with a consistent AI presenter, from a script or an idea.

• Build and publish websites and landing pages, then change them by asking.

• Make presentations and pitch decks, ready to present or download.

• Get research reports that read the web and cite their sources.

• Compose songs, jingles and voiceovers.

Your agent remembers your work across SuperCool, the web app, phone calls and texts, so you can say "make the ad from yesterday shorter" or "send me that logo again". Long jobs keep running in SuperCool while you chat, and the results come back here when they're ready.

SuperCool only works inside your own SuperCool account.

Connect your SuperCool account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
SuperCool是一款AI代理，可通过自然语言请求生成成品工作。连接您的SuperCool账户并在ChatGPT中提出需求：您的代理会规划它，在SuperCool账户中生成，并将结果作为图片、音频、可播放视频和链接返回到对话中。

使用SuperCool，您可以：

• 制作包含音乐、配音和字幕的视频广告、产品视频、社交媒体短视频和解释性视频

• 通过描述或您自己的照片，生成产品照片、图片广告和任何风格的品牌视觉内容

• 通过脚本或创意生成一致的AI主持人视频

• 构建并发布网站和落地页，之后通过提问即可修改

• 制作可直接演示或下载的演示文稿和路演演示文稿

• 获取能够浏览网络并引用来源的研究报告。

• 创作歌曲、广告曲和旁白。

您的代理会记住您在SuperCool平台、网页应用、电话及短信中的工作内容，因此您可以下达「把昨天的广告缩短」或「再发给我那个标志」等指令。在您聊天时，长时间任务仍会在SuperCool中运行，结果就在此处返回。

SuperCool仅在您的SuperCool账户内运行。

连接您的SuperCool账户即可开始。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make videos and video ads, Create images and product photos, Make talking-head presenter videos, Build and publish websites, Make presentations and pitch decks, Write research reports with sources, Compose music and voiceovers, Find and reopen earlier work

payload.name: regards.design
payload.description: 通过外观获取网站灵感
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
regards.design is a hand-picked library of real, well-made websites, cut into their sections (heroes, navigation, feature grids, pricing, footers and more), each screenshotted and searchable by how it looks: its mood, type, colour, imagery, motion and how experimental it is.

Ask the way you'd brief a designer: "experimental hero sections with striking type", "calm, minimal heroes with lots of white space", "design studio homepages that move". The sections that fit appear as screenshots in the chat. Open any of them on regards.design, see the rest of the page it came from, or ask for more like the ones you like.

Reach for it while the look of a website is still open: setting a visual direction for a brand, designing or redesigning a landing page, or finding references for a single section.

Making the page in Codex or another coding agent? The regards design skill (regards.design/skill) takes it further: it researches real sections for your brief, settles a direction, designs the page and checks it in a browser.

Sign in with your regards.design account to search.
payload.longDescription:
regards.design是一个精心挑选的真实优质网站库，网站被拆分为不同板块（首页头部、导航栏、功能网格、定价模块、页脚等），每个板块都进行了截图处理，并可通过外观特征进行搜索：包括整体氛围、字体风格、配色方案、图像素材、动态效果以及创新实验性程度

您可以像给设计师下需求一样提问：「具有冲击力字体的实验性首页头部」「充满留白的简约宁静首页」「会动态变化的设计工作室主页」。符合要求的板块会以截图形式出现在聊天界面中，可随时打开regards.design查看该截图所属的完整页面，或要求推荐更多相似风格的板块

在网站视觉风格尚未定型时即可使用：无论是确定品牌视觉方向、设计/重构落地页，还是为某个具体板块寻找参考素材

正在使用Codex或其他编码代理制作页面吗？
通过regards.design设计技能（regards.design/skill）可进一步拓展：根据您的需求调研真实板块案例，确定设计方向，完成页面设计并在浏览器中实时验证效果

使用您的regards.design账户登录以进行搜索

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search website sections by mood, type, colour, motion and novelty, Show sections as screenshots in the chat, Find sections like the ones you choose, Show every section of a page in order

payload.name: Hansora AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and work with AI directly inside ChatGPT using Hansora AI. Generate images, videos, audio, and other AI content through supported models and tools, all without leaving the conversation. Hansora brings multiple creative AI capabilities into one place so users can generate, transform, and manage different types of content from a single chat.
payload.longDescription:
通过Hansora AI在ChatGPT内部直接创建和使用AI。
通过支持的模型和工具生成图像、视频、音频及其他AI内容，无需离开聊天界面。
Hansora将多种创意AI功能整合到一个平台，让用户可通过单一聊天窗口完成内容生成、转换与管理。

payload.name: FXI Studio
payload.description: 从聊天中生成的电影级AI视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your FXI Studio account to direct cinematic stills and video clips from a conversation. Ask for a shot and FXI picks a suitable model for the job, shows the result inline and saves every take to your FXI library. Frame chaining turns 2 to 8 scene descriptions into clips where each clip starts on the last frame of the one before, so motion carries across shots. Compose a scene from your saved characters, check your credits and look up past generations at any time. Sign in with your FXI Studio account to get started.
payload.longDescription: 将您的FXI Studio账户连接，即可从对话中直接生成电影级静态图像和视频片段。请求一个镜头，FXI会为该任务选择合适的模型，直接在对话中显示结果，并将每次拍摄保存到您的FXI库中。帧链功能可将2到8个场景描述转换为视频片段，每个片段从前一个片段的最后一帧开始，使动作在镜头间自然衔接。从已保存的角色中构建场景，随时查看信用额度并查阅过往生成记录。使用您的FXI Studio账户登录即可开始。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: Kapwing
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Translate, subtitle, and dub videos and audio from one language to another using Kapwing. Upload a video from your computer, transcribe it, add subtitles in the original or a translated language, and dub the speech into other languages in voices cloned from the original speakers. You can also browse your workspace's recent projects and media library, check your remaining credits, and export projects to MP4 with a download link when they're done. Every result links to the project in the Kapwing editor for further changes.

Limitations: the plugin only works with workspaces your connected Kapwing account belongs to, and it cannot delete projects or media. Transcription, translation, and dubbing use your workspace's existing Kapwing credits. Timeline edits such as trims and transitions happen in the Kapwing editor. Dubbing replaces the audio only and is not lip-synced.
payload.longDescription:
通过Kapwing将视频和音频从一种语言翻译、添加字幕并进行配音。
从您的电脑上传视频，进行语音转文字，添加原始语言或翻译后的字幕，并使用从原声演员克隆的语音将语音配音到其他语言。
您还可以浏览工作区的最近项目和媒体库，查看剩余积分，并在项目完成后通过下载链接将项目导出为MP4格式。
每个结果都会链接到Kapwing编辑器中的项目，以便进行进一步修改。

限制：该插件仅适用于您连接的Kapwing账户所属的工作区，且无法删除项目或媒体。
语音转文字、翻译和配音将使用工作区现有的Kapwing积分。
时间轴编辑（如裁剪和转场）在Kapwing编辑器中完成。
配音仅替换音频，且不进行唇形同步。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Dub videos and audio, Translate and transcribe media, Add subtitles, Upload assets, Access workspace projects, Export projects to MP4, Download exported videos

payload.name: YouWorkForThem
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover fonts, graphics, and photos from YouWorkForThem. Search by visual style or subject, explore product previews and designer details, and find visually similar fonts. Browse real catalog results through interactive cards for creative inspiration, with optional links to view more on YouWorkForThem.
payload.longDescription: 从YouWorkForThem探索字体、图形和照片。按视觉风格或主题搜索，查看产品预览和设计师详情，找到视觉相似的字体。通过互动卡片浏览真实目录结果以获取创意灵感，附有可选链接可前往YouWorkForThem查看更多内容。

payload.name: LYRC
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LYRC makes lyric videos for independent musicians. Ask ChatGPT to make a lyric video for your song, make a music video for a new single, or make Instagram Reels for a release, and LYRC builds them from your songs.

You set up a song once at lyrc.studio. LYRC transcribes and times the lyrics and puts cut markers on the beat. After that, ChatGPT can:
- make a new video for that song and fill every cut with stock footage (30 moods, from club nights to nature) or your own clips
- show you the storyboard right in the chat
- switch between lyric animation styles, or turn them off and set the font, colors and outline yourself
- fix a misheard word or retime a line
- add color grades and transitions that land on the beat
- swap, zoom or lock individual clips
- pull clips out of a video link
- make up to 30 videos at once for a release, then keep or ditch each one
- export a finished MP4 and post it to Instagram now or schedule it

Exports and Instagram posts only go through after you confirm them in the chat. Finished videos play in the chat with a download link that doesn't expire.

Limits: you need a LYRC account with at least one song set up at lyrc.studio. Songs are uploaded in the LYRC app, not in ChatGPT. Instagram posting needs an Instagram professional account connected in LYRC.
payload.longDescription:
LYRC为独立音乐人制作歌词视频。
让ChatGPT为您制作歌曲的歌词视频，为新单曲制作音乐视频，或为作品发布制作Instagram Reels，LYRC将根据您的歌曲生成这些内容。

您只需在lyrc.studio中设置一首歌曲一次。
LYRC会转录并同步歌词，在节拍上添加剪辑标记。
之后ChatGPT可以：
- 为该歌曲创建新视频，用库存素材（30种情绪风格，从夜店场景到自然画面）或您自己的片段填充每个剪辑
- 在聊天中直接展示故事板
- 切换歌词动画风格，或关闭动画自行设置字体、颜色和描边
- 修正听错的歌词或重新调整语句节奏
- 添加符合节拍的调色和转场效果
- 对单个片段进行替换、缩放或锁定操作
- 从视频链接中提取片段
- 一次性为作品发布生成最多30个视频，之后可保留或舍弃每个视频
- 导出完成的MP4文件并立即发布到Instagram，或安排发布时间

导出和Instagram发布只有在您通过聊天确认后才会完成。
完成的视频在聊天中播放时会附带不会过期的下载链接。

限制条件：您需要拥有在lyrc.studio中至少设置了一首歌曲的LYRC账户。
歌曲需在LYRC应用中上传，而非在ChatGPT中上传。
Instagram发布功能需要已在LYRC中关联的Instagram专业账号。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make lyric videos, Restyle lyrics, Edit lyrics and timing, Export MP4s, Post to Instagram

payload.name: TrackGleam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TrackGleam helps musicians, producers, podcasters and AI-music creators finish songs for release. Share a track or its numbers and get a plain-English read of what is holding it back - loudness versus streaming level, clipping, muddy low mids, harsh highs, stereo problems - with practical targets for Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube and TikTok. When a tool can do the job, the plugin gives you a TrackGleam link that opens with a suggested starting style: free automatic mastering with WAV and MP3 downloads, a vocal-over-a-beat mixer, a Spotify Canvas maker, a music visualizer for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, a cover art maker and release-check tools. TrackGleam processes your audio in your own browser; your song is not uploaded. The plugin does not master or export files inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: TrackGleam帮助音乐人、制作人、播客创作者和AI音乐创作者完成歌曲制作并进行发布。上传一首曲目或其数据，即可获得用通俗英语解析的诊断报告，揭示歌曲存在的问题——如响度与流媒体音量的对比、削波现象、低中频浑浊、高频刺耳、立体声问题等，并提供针对Spotify、Apple Music、YouTube和TikTok的实际优化目标。当工具能完成任务时，插件会为你生成TrackGleam链接，直接打开后可选择以下功能：免费自动母带处理（支持WAV和MP3下载）、人声配节奏混音器、Spotify Canvas制作器、适用于Reels/TikTok/ Shorts的音乐可视化工具、封面艺术生成器以及发布检测工具。TrackGleam在你的浏览器中处理音频数据；你的歌曲不会被上传。该插件不会在ChatGPT内部进行母带处理或文件导出。

payload.name: AppScreenshotStudio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots for your app. Describe what the app does and AppScreenshotStudio designs a full set of store screenshots at the exact sizes Apple and Google require. Refine the set by describing the change: shorter headlines, a new colour palette, a different layout, a tilted device, or one background stretched across several screenshots. When it looks right, export the PNGs, ready to upload to App Store Connect or Google Play Console.
payload.longDescription: 为您的应用创建应用商店和Google Play截图。描述应用功能，AppScreenshotStudio将按照苹果和谷歌要求的精确尺寸设计一套完整的应用商店截图。通过描述修改内容来优化截图集：更短的标题、新的配色方案、不同的布局、倾斜的设备角度，或单一背景跨多张截图延伸。确认无误后，导出PNG格式文件，即可上传至App Store Connect或Google Play Console。

payload.name: SlidesAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SlidesAI is an AI presentation maker for creating work, business and school presentations. Turn an idea, your notes or an uploaded document into a polished presentation without leaving ChatGPT.

What you can make:
• Pitch decks for startups, products and fundraising
• Simple, clear lessons for teachers and students
• Reports, team updates and project plans
• Flowcharts, process maps and other complex diagrams
• Data slides with charts and tables
• Branded decks created from a PPTX you've imported into SlidesAI

Every slide stays editable. Fine-tune text, layout and design in the SlidesAI editor, then export your presentation to PowerPoint (PPTX), Google Slides or PDF.

SlidesAI designs the slides, saves them to your account and gives you a link to open the deck in the SlidesAI editor.
payload.longDescription:
SlidesAI是一款AI演示文稿制作工具，可用于创建工作、商业和学校演示文稿。将一个想法、您的笔记或上传的文档转化为精美的演示文稿，而无需离开ChatGPT

您可以制作：
• 初创企业、产品和融资用的路演演示文稿
• 适用于教师和学生的简洁清晰课程课件
• 报告、团队更新和项目计划
• 流程图、流程图和其他复杂图表
• 包含图表和表格的数据幻灯片
• 通过导入PPTX文件创建的品牌化演示文稿

每张幻灯片均可编辑。在SlidesAI编辑器中微调文本、版式和设计，然后将演示文稿导出为PowerPoint（PPTX）、Google Slides或PDF格式

SlidesAI会设计幻灯片，将其保存到您的账户，并提供一个链接以便在SlidesAI编辑器中打开该演示文稿

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create pitch decks, lessons and reports, Create branded decks from your imported PPTX, Turn uploaded documents into slides, Diagrams, charts, tables and AI images, Add slides to an existing presentation, Export to PPTX, Google Slides or PDF

payload.name: CutPro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CutPro finds the best moments of a long video and turns them into short, captioned vertical clips ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

Paste a YouTube, Twitch, Kick or TikTok link and CutPro clips the video, ranks the clips by how engaging they are, applies your saved templates, renders the final MP4s and posts them to the accounts you connected on cut.pro, now or on a schedule. ChatGPT always asks before starting a job or publishing anything.

It also follows your favorite channels: CutPro clips a live stream while it airs, every 10 minutes, so the best moments are ready before the broadcast ends. And it transcribes audio and video into timed captions in SRT, VTT or plain text.

Everything happens in your own CutPro workspace, the same one you use on cut.pro.
payload.longDescription:
CutPro会找出长视频中的精彩片段，将其制作成适合TikTok、Reels和Shorts的带字幕竖版短视频

粘贴YouTube、Twitch、Kick或TikTok链接后，CutPro会自动剪辑视频，根据吸引力排序片段，应用您保存的模板，生成最终MP4文件，并发布到您在cut.pro上连接的账号，支持立即发布或定时发布。
ChatGPT在开始任务或发布内容前会先询问确认。

它还会跟踪您关注的频道：CutPro会在直播进行时每10分钟剪辑一次，确保最佳片段在直播结束前就已准备就绪。
同时可将音视频内容转录为带时间戳的字幕，支持SRT、VTT或纯文本格式。

所有操作都在您专属的CutPro工作区完成，与您在cut.pro上使用的界面相同。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Clip long videos into short vertical clips, Clip live streams while they air, Apply your saved editing templates, Render clips to MP4 and share download links, Post clips to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, Transcribe audio and video into captions

payload.name: varg.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Generate images, video, voiceover and music from text prompts and reference files, using the generation models available in your varg.ai account. Find a voice preset and generate speech, browse and render published video templates, or render your own multi-scene video with captions and voiceover.

Video and render jobs run in the background: you can check their status and view the result when they finish. Generated and uploaded files are saved to your varg.ai library, and you can check your credit balance, spend and job history. Generations use credits from your varg.ai account.
payload.longDescription:
通过文本提示和参考文件生成图像、视频、配音和音乐，使用您varg.ai账户中可用的生成模型。选择语音预设生成语音，浏览并渲染已发布的视频模板，或使用字幕和配音功能渲染您自己的多场景视频。

视频和渲染任务在后台运行：您可以查看其状态并在完成后查看结果。生成和上传的文件将保存到您的varg.ai资料库，您可以查看信用额度、消费记录和任务历史。生成内容将消耗您varg.ai账户中的信用额度。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate images, Generate video, Generate voiceover and music, Render templates and multi-scene ads, Upload and manage media files, Check balance and spend

payload.name: UlazAI Media
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UlazAI Media helps users choose a supported image model, prepare a private 1K image request, create it from a recurring sponsored allowance, and retrieve the completed private file.
payload.longDescription: UlazAI Media帮助用户选择受支持的图像模型，准备私有1K图像请求，通过定期赞助额度生成，并获取完成的私有文件。

payload.name: Outfit Preview: Virtual Try-On
payload.description: Try clothes on your own photo
payload.summaryOriginal: Try clothes on your own photo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Preview an attached garment on an attached person photo. Compare the original and result inline with fullscreen, Open and Download. This is a visual concept; it cannot determine body measurements, sizing or fit. A connected Firemoon account is required.

payload.name: Shorts Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create 15-second videos from a brief or up to four selected still images. Preview settings and confirm generation, track progress, adjust captions, opening text, end cards, visual look and music, and download finished MP4s. For creators preparing short video content. Requires a connected Shorts Generator account with video-generation access.
payload.longDescription: 从简短描述或最多四张选定的静态图片生成15秒视频。预览设置并确认生成，跟踪进度，调整字幕、开头文字、结束卡片、视觉风格和音乐，下载完成的MP4文件。面向准备短视频内容的创作者。需要连接具备视频生成权限的Shorts Generator账户。

payload.name: NOLGIA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create images, video, voiceover and edits with guided presets and your own media. Browse a visual preset gallery, filter by image or video, and open a preset to see examples, estimated cost and the questions it needs answered.

Custom widgets keep the workflow inside ChatGPT: fill in text fields, choose options, and select reference images from your NOLGIA library. Search and filter your saved assets in a visual grid, then reuse a logo, product photo or clip in your next creation.

Remake a clip you already have with Miroge. Keep its movement and give it a new subject, swap one person or product for another, or move the whole scene into a new world, then compare the remake with your original.

Turn one steady take into every camera angle with Multicam. See which angles your clip can have before anything is made, render only the ones you pick, in sync over the original sound, and get a highlight edit that cuts between them.

Choose a preset for a YouTube thumbnail, product demo, logo reveal, animation and more, or describe a task directly. Generate supported media, check video job progress, retrieve finished files, and organize assets with projects and tags. Cut short vertical clips from a longer video, make a 3D model from product photos, or edit one image step by step and go back to any earlier version. Some multi-shot productions return a brief for NOLGIA Agent and, where supported, a single preview scene rather than a completed production.

A NOLGIA account is required. Browsing presets and your library is free; generation uses NOLGIA credits.
payload.longDescription:
通过引导预设和自有媒体创建图像、视频、配音及编辑内容。浏览视觉预设图库，按图像或视频筛选，打开预设查看示例、预估成本以及需要回答的问题。

自定义组件将工作流保留在ChatGPT内：填写文本字段、选择选项，并从您的NOLGIA库中选取参考图像。在视觉网格中搜索和筛选已保存的素材，然后在下一次创作中重复使用logo、产品照片或片段。

通过Miroge重新制作已有片段。保留原有动态并赋予新主题，替换其中的人员或产品，或把整个场景迁移至新世界，然后将重制版本与原版进行对比。

通过Multicam将单个稳定镜头转化为所有摄像机角度。在制作任何内容前查看片段可能拥有的角度，仅渲染您选择的角度，同步原始音频，并生成可在不同角度间切换的精彩片段剪辑。

选择适用于YouTube缩略图、产品演示、logo揭示、动画等的预设，或直接描述任务。生成支持的媒体内容，查看视频任务进度，获取完成文件，并通过项目和标签管理素材。从长视频中剪辑短竖版片段，通过产品照片制作3D模型，或分步骤编辑单张图片并返回任何早期版本。部分多镜头制作会为NOLGIA Agent生成简报，在支持的场景中则提供单个预览场景而非完整作品。

需要NOLGIA账户。浏览预设和库内容免费；生成内容使用NOLGIA积分。

payload.name: PrintNexus Toolbox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PrintNexus Toolbox brings 3D printing tools into ChatGPT for makers and 3D printing enthusiasts.

With Lithophane Maker, turn an image into a flat lithophane: a thin 3D printed plate that reveals the image when light shines through it. Set the width in millimeters, inspect the model in an interactive 3D preview, and compare lit and backlit views. Download your model as an STL or 3MF file.

The current release supports flat lithophanes printed in one color. More 3D printing tools are planned for future updates.
payload.longDescription:
PrintNexus工具箱将3D打印工具带入ChatGPT，服务于创作者和3D打印爱好者。

通过Lithophane Maker功能，可将图像转换为扁平浮雕：一种薄型3D打印板，当光线穿透时会显现图像。
设置宽度（毫米），在交互式3D预览中检查模型，并对比光照和背光视图。
将模型下载为STL或3MF文件。

当前版本仅支持单色扁平浮雕打印。
更多3D打印工具计划在后续更新中推出。

payload.name: HyeAn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HyeAn searches the connected user's image and game-asset library from a natural-language description. Empty libraries use clearly labeled shared demo samples. Users can inspect their account plan, quota, and index status.
payload.longDescription: HyeAn通过自然语言描述搜索用户连接的图像和游戏素材库。空库会使用清晰标注的共享演示样本。用户可以查看其账户计划、配额和索引状态。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search image assets, View account quota

payload.name: Segmind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate images, audio, and video directly with Segmind. Turn your ideas into high-quality creative content using a range of generative AI models, all from one place. Whether you’re creating visuals, producing audio, or experimenting with video, Segmind makes it easy to go from a simple prompt to a finished result.
payload.longDescription:
通过Segmind直接生成图像、音频和视频。
使用一系列生成式AI模型，将您的创意转化为高质量的原创内容，所有功能尽在一处。
无论您是创作视觉内容、制作音频还是探索视频制作，Segmind都能让您轻松地将简单提示转化为最终成果。

payload.name: Alpenmarketing Bildkompressor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Komprimiere ein hochgeladenes PNG-, JPG-, WebP- oder AVIF-Bild für E-Mail, Website oder Messenger. Das Plugin verarbeitet die Datei während des Aufrufs, gibt das optimierte Bild und die Größenänderung zurück. Qualität und Ausgabeformat können gewählt werden. Dateien bis 8 MB; das Ergebnis wird nicht dauerhaft bei Alpenmarketing gespeichert.
payload.longDescription: 在调用时压缩已上传的PNG、JPG、WebP或AVIF图片，用于电子邮件、网站或即时通讯工具。插件在调用时处理文件，返回优化后的图片和尺寸调整结果。可选择质量等级和输出格式。支持最大8MB的文件；结果不会在Alpenmarketing长期保存。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Bilddateien im Chat komprimieren, PNG, JPG, WebP und AVIF als Eingabe, Größenersparnis ausweisen

payload.name: Stickers.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn a design into real stickers without leaving the conversation. Find the right sticker type, choose size, material and quantity, and see the price from stickers.com. Share or generate an image and it is attached to your order automatically, with a check that it will print sharply at the size you picked. When you're ready, check out securely on stickers.com.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开对话即可将设计转化为实际贴纸。选择合适的贴纸类型，确定尺寸、材质和数量，即可查看Stickers.com的价格。分享或生成图片后，系统会自动将其附加到订单中，并确认所选尺寸下打印效果是否清晰。确认无误后，可在Stickers.com上安全结账。

payload.name: Alpenmarketing QR-Code
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Erzeuge einen echten QR-Code als PNG für eine Webadresse, Text, E-Mail-Adresse, Telefonnummer, SMS oder WhatsApp. Das Bild wird direkt im Chat erzeugt und kann für Flyer, Speisekarten oder Einladungen verwendet werden. Vor dem Druck mit mehreren Geräten testen.
payload.longDescription:
为网址、文本、电子邮件地址、电话号码、短信或WhatsApp生成真正的PNG格式二维码。
图片会直接在聊天中生成，可用于传单、菜单或邀请函。
打印前请使用多个设备进行测试。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: QR-Code als PNG erzeugen, Links und Kontaktdaten codieren, Farben für den QR-Code wählen

payload.name: WFI — WhatFontIs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Identify fonts from screenshots and images with WhatFontIs. Compare matching fonts, preview uppercase letters, lowercase letters and numbers, and open font information pages. Results include available source and license-category information. Matches are suggestions, not a guarantee of the original font.
payload.longDescription:
通过WhatFontIs识别截图和图片中的字体。
对比匹配字体，预览大写字母、小写字母和数字，打开字体信息页面。
结果包含可用来源和许可类别信息。
匹配结果仅为建议，不保证与原始字体完全一致。

payload.name: Misar.Blog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Misar.Blog lets you write, publish and grow a blog from ChatGPT. Draft and edit articles, publish now or schedule for later, organise posts into series, research topics, generate SEO-friendly titles and cover images, and review comments, reactions, newsletter subscribers and traffic.

It is built for writers, creators and teams who publish on Misar.Blog. A Misar.Blog account is required, and the plugin only changes articles owned by the signed-in account.
payload.longDescription:
Misar.Blog让你能够通过ChatGPT撰写、发布并扩展你的博客。可草拟编辑文章，立即发布或预约后续发布，将文章整理成系列专题，进行主题调研，生成SEO优化的标题和封面图片，并查看评论、互动数据、通讯订阅者和访问流量情况。

本插件专为在Misar.Blog发布内容的创作者、内容创作者及团队设计。需要拥有Misar.Blog账户，且该插件仅对已登录账户所拥有的文章进行修改。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Write articles, Publish posts, Manage series, Research topics, Track analytics

payload.name: Agent-Native Design
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create interactive prototypes in your Agent-Native Design workspace. Browse saved designs, templates, design systems, and snapshots; start new designs, generate visual directions, and refine saved prototypes through chat. This connection works with designs in the connected Agent-Native workspace. It does not connect to local repositories, modify a running website, export files, or deploy an application.
payload.longDescription: 在您的Agent-Native Design工作区中创建交互式原型。浏览已保存的设计、模板、设计系统和快照；新建设计、生成视觉方案，并通过聊天界面优化已保存的原型。此连接仅适用于已连接的Agent-Native工作区中的设计，不会连接到本地仓库、修改运行中的网站、导出文件或部署应用程序。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create interactive prototypes, Explore design directions, Apply workspace design systems

payload.name: Mondovo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mondovo is a website design and creation tool for business owners, creators and agencies. Turn a description of your business into three distinct website designs, compare visual previews and choose the direction you prefer. Build a landing page or a business website without writing code.

Refine your chosen design in plain language: change colors, typography, images, copy and page layout, or add new pages. Interactive cards show your designs, previews and progress in the conversation. When you are ready, ask Mondovo to publish the chosen website and share its live link. Your projects and revision history are saved in your Mondovo account.

To support work on your website, you can also browse saved Creative Studio images and videos, review social post drafts, check video project progress and view contacts collected by your website. payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WebCAD is a CAD app that runs in the browser. With WebCAD connected, your assistant can design mechanical parts and simple mechanisms for you in WebCAD: it writes the model in ArchScript, WebCAD's text modelling language, builds it in WebCAD, shows you pictures of it, and gives you a STEP file that opens in other CAD tools or can go to a machine shop or a 3D-print service.

What you can ask for:
- Plates, brackets, enclosures, pulleys and other machined or printed parts, with holes, slots, pockets and rounded edges.
- Assemblies with joints that move, such as hinges, arms and linkages. WebCAD reports parts that collide or come apart as a joint moves through its range.
- Gear pairs and simple drivetrains.
- A first stress check of a part: a material, a fixed face and a load, with the peak stress and how far the part bends.

What you get:
- Every build reports PASS, or FAIL with the problems found, so the assistant can fix them before it calls a part done.
- Pictures of the model from the directions you ask for.
- A STEP file, made only when the build passes. Download links work for 24 hours.
- In assistants that show apps in the conversation, a 3D view of the part that you can turn and zoom, with a STEP button.

Limits:
- A PASS means the model builds in WebCAD. Whether a part is right for its purpose (fit, strength, safety, manufacturability) still needs a person's review.
- Stress results are a first check for a person to review, not an engineering sign-off.
- A build takes from about 15 seconds to a few minutes.

You need a WebCAD account (app.webcad.ca). WebCAD does not keep your scripts after a build; STEP files are deleted after 7 days, and the 3D view's part shapes after 24 hours.

payload.name: Moon & Star Map
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
See the real Moon and the real night sky for the dates that matter: a birthday, a wedding, the night you met.

Moon & Star Map computes the Moon phase for any date from 1800 to 2200 with astronomical algorithms (Jean Meeus): the phase name, the exact illumination percentage, the moon age in days, whether it was waxing or waning, the exact times of the new, quarter and full moons, and the next full and new moon. Give two birthdays and it tells you whether your moons "complete each other" (half a lunar cycle apart, so one moon's light fills the other's shadow), with a match score and an honest explanation. Ask for a month and you get a moon phase calendar with every day drawn.

For a star map, name a city, a date and a local time. Time zones and daylight saving time are handled for you, and the city match is stated in the reply. The map shows about 2,900 stars from the Yale Bright Star Catalog sized by brightness, the constellation lines, the horizon, the cardinal points and the Moon in its real position and phase. You see a live preview, can switch between four styles (midnight, black, paper, ink) and toggle lines and labels, then download vector poster PDFs at 12x18 in, 18x24 in, A3, US Letter and A4 (with 0.125 in print bleed), an SVG, and a share page anyone can open.

Moon posters: one date's moon as a large print, two dates side by side for couples, or a lunar calendar of a whole year.

Good for anniversary, wedding, birthday and new-baby keepsakes, classroom moon charts, and answering "what was the moon on the day I was born?".

Accuracy: moon illumination matches an independent ephemeris within 0.5 percentage points and phase times within about a minute for 1900-2100; star positions match within 0.1 degree.

Limitations: decorative keepsakes, not for navigation or telescope pointing. Planets, the Milky Way and eclipses are not drawn. Cities come from a list of about 11,000 places; give a nearby larger city if yours is missing. PDF text covers Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters; Chinese, Japanese and Korean titles appear in the SVG only.

Data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0), Yale Bright Star Catalog, constellation lines from d3-celestial by Olaf Frohn (BSD-3-Clause), astronomia (MIT).

生成星空图时，请指定城市、日期和当地时间。系统自动处理时区和夏令时问题，并在回复中注明城市匹配结果。地图显示来自耶鲁亮星目录的约2900颗恒星（按亮度比例缩放）、星座连线、地平线、方位点及真实位置和月相的月亮。可查看实时预览，切换四种风格（午夜、黑底、纸张、墨水），开启/关闭连线和标签，下载矢量海报PDF（尺寸包括12x18英寸、18x24英寸、A3、US Letter、A4，含0.125英寸印刷出血区）、SVG文件以及可分享的网页链接。

适用于纪念日、婚礼、生日和新生儿纪念品、教室月相图，以及回答「我出生那天的月亮是什么样？」这类问题。

使用限制：仅限装饰性纪念品，不可用于导航或望远镜指向。不绘制行星、银河系和日食月食。城市数据来自约11000个地点列表；若您的城市未列出，可提供附近较大城市。PDF文本支持拉丁文、希腊文和斯拉夫字母；中文、日文、韩文标题仅显示于SVG文件。

payload.name: PromptKosh
payload.description: 创建具有特定风格的图像
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find a public PromptKosh style or use a style ID from promptkosh.in. PromptKosh sends the style prompt and any required inputs to ChatGPT, which can create the image using your ChatGPT account’s available image features. No PromptKosh account is needed.
payload.longDescription:
查找公共的PromptKosh风格或使用promptkosh.in提供的风格ID。
PromptKosh会将风格提示和必要输入发送至ChatGPT，即可通过你的ChatGPT账户可用的图像功能生成图像。
无需PromptKosh账户。

payload.name: Lazybird
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn scripts into ready-to-use voiceover MP3s without leaving ChatGPT. Write or polish your script with ChatGPT, then ask Lazybird to read it aloud: you get an audio player in the chat and an MP3 you can download and drop into your video, podcast, ad, audiobook or course.

What you can do:
- Find the right voice by describing it ("a calm British narrator for a nature documentary"). Lazybird searches 500+ voices in 150+ languages and accents, plus the voices in your own library, including your cloned voices.
- Generate speech from any text with the voice you picked, adjusting the speaking speed or the language and accent.
- Design a brand-new voice from a description ("a raspy, ancient wizard with a slow, mysterious delivery"), listen to the sample, and save it to your Lazybird library to reuse in ChatGPT or in Lazybird Studio.
- Check how many characters you have left.

Connect your Lazybird account the first time you use it. Lazybird can't see your password, payment details or API keys, and you can disconnect ChatGPT any time in Lazybird Settings → Connected apps.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT内将脚本转换为可直接使用的配音MP3文件。与ChatGPT协作撰写或润色脚本后，让Lazybird为您朗读：您将在聊天中获得一个音频播放器，并可下载MP3文件直接嵌入视频、播客、广告、有声书或课程中。

您可以实现以下操作：
- 通过描述寻找合适的语音（「为自然纪录片寻找冷静的英国旁白」）。
Lazybird可搜索500+种语音（涵盖150+种语言和口音），以及您个人语音库中的语音（包括您克隆的语音）。
- 选择心仪语音生成语音，可调整语速、语言或口音。
- 通过描述创建全新语音（「沙哑的古老巫师，语速缓慢且神秘」），试听样音后保存至Lazybird库，后续可在ChatGPT或Lazybird Studio中重复使用。
- 查看剩余字符数。

首次使用时需连接您的Lazybird账户。
Lazybird无法查看您的密码、支付信息或API密钥，您可在Lazybird设置→已连接应用中随时断开ChatGPT连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate voiceover MP3s from text, Search 500+ voices in 150+ languages and accents, Design a new voice from a description, Save voices to your Lazybird library, Check your character balance

payload.name: App Listing Screenshots
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots right in ChatGPT—without local rendering setup. Turn one or more captures into a single image or a coordinated series with headlines, backgrounds, and device frames. Choose supported store sizes or custom dimensions, preview the result, and download full-resolution PNGs in one ZIP. Try the workflow with a sample if you do not have captures ready. This creates image files; it does not publish to store accounts. Source images and projects remain stored until you request deletion; exports are deleted after 24 hours.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT内直接创建应用商店和Google Play截图——无需本地渲染设置。
将一个或多个截图转换为单张图像或包含标题、背景和设备框架的协调系列。
选择应用商店支持的尺寸或自定义尺寸，预览结果，并以一个ZIP包下载全分辨率PNG图片。
如果您尚未准备好截图，可以使用示例试用此工作流程。
此操作仅生成图片文件；不会发布到商店账户。
源图像和项目将保留至您请求删除；导出文件将在24小时后删除。

payload.name: Lovart
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lovart generates images and videos from text prompts and reference images. Edit images using text instructions, replace image backgrounds, upscale images or videos, and view recent Lovart projects supported by this connector. Choose from the available models, with supported inputs and settings varying by model.
payload.longDescription:
Lovart通过文本提示和参考图片生成图像和视频。
可通过文本指令编辑图片，替换图片背景，放大图片或视频，并查看此连接器支持的最近Lovart项目。
可从可用模型中进行选择，不同模型支持的输入和设置可能有所差异。

payload.name: Nova Creative
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create AI images, short videos, and creative variations from a brief or your reference media. Explore visual directions, animate product images, and refine the result in a reusable Nova Creative workflow.

Reopen saved projects, change selected steps, and continue from the same editable workflow. Review available models and estimated usage, confirm generation in the Nova card, follow progress, see previews, and download finished files with a link back to your project.

Requires a connected Nova Creative account. Generation uses the models and usage available to that account.
payload.longDescription:
通过简报或参考素材创建AI图像、短视频和创意变体，探索视觉方向、为产品图片添加动画效果，并在可重复使用的新月创意工作流中优化最终结果。

重新打开已保存项目，修改选定步骤并从同一可编辑工作流继续操作。查看可用模型及预估使用量，在新月卡片中确认生成任务，跟踪进度、预览效果，并通过链接下载完成文件返回项目界面。

需要连接新月创意账户，生成内容将使用该账户对应的模型资源和可用配额。

payload.name: Julius: PowerPoint & Slides
payload.description: AI演示文稿与幻灯片制作工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Julius is an AI presentation maker for creating and editing PowerPoint slide decks. Turn a prompt, outline, notes, Word document, or supported text-based PDF into an editable PPTX presentation with a clear story and consistent slide design.

Create slides from your material: Use text to PowerPoint, document to presentation, and PDF to PPT workflows to turn source content into slide titles, concise talking points, tables, charts, and speaker notes. PDF conversion rebuilds the content as slides rather than reproducing every page exactly.

Make a deck for your audience: Build pitch decks, investor presentations, sales decks, client proposals, business presentations, project updates, training slides, research talks, and educational slideshows. Choose the audience, tone, length, and key message.

Edit and refine presentations: Revise slide copy, reorder sections, adjust layouts and typography, and update supported tables and charts. Work from a new deck or an existing PowerPoint file, with changes handled through format-aware processing.

Apply your presentation style: Use supplied brand colors, fonts, logos, and layout references to create branded slides. Prepare a matching outline, speaker script, or handout when needed.

Save an editable PowerPoint: Get a real .pptx file with editable text and supported slide elements. Continue working with saved presentation files in your Julius library. When requested, create an HTML slideshow or a separate document handout.

Your files stay private unless you ask to publish a completed presentation and receive a public link. PowerPoint requests produce .pptx files; support for an existing deck depends on its features. Connect your Julius account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
Julius是用于创建和编辑PowerPoint幻灯片演示文稿的AI制作工具。将提示、大纲、笔记、Word文档或支持的文本型PDF转换为包含清晰叙事和统一幻灯片设计的可编辑PPTX演示文稿。

从您的素材创建幻灯片：通过文本转PowerPoint、文档转演示文稿、PDF转PPT工作流，将源内容转化为幻灯片标题、简洁的演讲要点、表格、图表和演讲者备注。PDF转换会将内容重新构建为幻灯片，而不是逐页复制。

为您的受众制作演示文稿：创建路演演示文稿、投资者汇报、销售演示、客户提案、商务汇报、项目更新、培训幻灯片、研究报告演讲和教育课件。选择受众对象、语气风格、篇幅长度和核心信息。

编辑和优化演示文稿：修改幻灯片内容、调整章节顺序、更改布局排版和字体样式，更新支持的表格和图表。可从新创建的演示文稿或现有PowerPoint文件进行编辑，通过格式感知处理技术实现修改。

应用您的演示文稿风格：使用提供的品牌配色、字体、Logo和版式参考创建品牌化幻灯片。必要时可准备配套的大纲、演讲脚本或纸质手册。

保存可编辑的PowerPoint文件：获取包含可编辑文字和支持的幻灯片元素的真实.pptx文件。可在Julius资料库中继续编辑保存的演示文稿文件。如需可生成HTML幻灯片或独立文档手册。

您的文件保持私密，除非您主动发布完整演示文稿并获取公开链接。PowerPoint请求将生成.pptx文件；对现有演示文稿的支持取决于其具体功能。连接您的Julius账户即可开始使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create editable PowerPoint decks, Turn text and documents into slides, Revise supported PPTX elements, Apply supplied branding, Create presentation handouts, Save presentation files, Publish presentations

payload.name: Portrait Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Restyle an attached portrait with backdrop, lighting and framing choices. Preview results inline or compare variations in the portrait workspace. Download images and share a chosen result with chat. AI editing may change facial details; inspect likeness before use. A connected Firemoon account is required.
payload.longDescription:
通过背景、灯光和构图选择重新设计附加人像。
直接预览效果或在人像工作区中比较不同版本。
下载图片并通过聊天分享选定结果。
AI编辑可能会改变面部细节；使用前请检查相似度。
需要连接Firemoon账户。

payload.name: Aaina Product Photos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Aaina is a product photo studio for online sellers. Share one photo of your product (clothing and ethnic wear such as kurtas, sarees and lehengas, jewellery, bags, shoes or accessories) and Aaina shows it worn or held by a realistic studio model, in poses and scenes that suit the product, ready for listings on marketplaces and your own shop.

What you can do in ChatGPT:
- Tag @Aaina, attach a product photo and ask for model photos. The Aaina card reads the product and suggests models, poses and scenes; you can name a model or scene yourself (for example "on Aaina in a white studio").
- Check the choices on the card, then press Make. Photos are made only when you press Make.
- Watch the photos arrive, download them, or open the shoot in Aaina for marketplace sizes.
- Ask to see your photos: the Your photos tab shows the photos you made with Aaina on the website or in ChatGPT, newest first, ready to download.
- Ask which poses or scenes suit your product.

Who it's for: sellers and brands who need consistent catalogue photos without a photoshoot.

Good to know:
- You need an Aaina account (sign in or create one when you connect).
- Studio models are fictional people created for Aaina. Aaina works from product photos only: it doesn't edit photos of real people, and in ChatGPT it offers adult models only.
- Each photo takes about a minute.
payload.longDescription:
Aaina是在线卖家的产品摄影工作室。上传一张产品照片（服装和民族服饰如库塔、纱丽和连衣裙、珠宝、包袋、鞋子或配饰），Aaina会将产品展示在符合产品特点的姿势和场景中的真实工作室模特身上，适用于市场平台和您的店铺销售。

在ChatGPT中可以实现以下操作：
- @Aaina，上传产品照片并请求模特照片。
Aaina卡片会识别产品并推荐模特、姿势和场景；您也可以自行指定模特或场景（例如「Aaina在白色工作室」）。
- 查看卡片上的选项，然后点击生成。
只有在您点击生成时才会制作照片。
- 查看照片结果，下载照片，或在Aaina中打开拍摄以获取市场尺寸。
- 请求查看您的照片：「我的照片」标签页会展示您通过网站或ChatGPT生成的照片，按最新顺序排列，可直接下载。
- 询问哪种姿势或场景适合您的产品。

适用于需要一致目录照片但无需拍摄的卖家和品牌。

注意事项：
- 需要Aaina账户（连接时可登录或注册）。
- 工作室模特是为Aaina创建的虚构人物。
Aaina仅基于产品照片工作：它不会编辑真人照片，在ChatGPT中仅提供成人模特。
- 每张照片大约需要一分钟。

payload.name: Theme Emporium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Theme Emporium helps users browse ready-made visual themes, inspect theme details, and generate a structured, non-persistent UI theme preview from a text brief directly inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Theme Emporium让用户在ChatGPT内部直接浏览现成视觉主题、查看主题详情，并根据文本简报生成结构化非持久化UI主题预览。

payload.name: Gulab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gulab connects your Gulab account to a range of image and video generation models. Describe an image or a short clip and Gulab submits the generation and shows the result in the chat; videos run in the background and appear when ready. You can also save results into Gulab projects, upload reference images, check your credit balance and usage, and open your work on the Gulab canvas at gulab.ai. Generations use credits from your Gulab account.
payload.longDescription: Gulab将您的Gulab账户连接到多种图像和视频生成模型。描述一张图像或一段短片，Gulab会提交生成请求并在聊天中展示结果；视频在后台运行，准备就绪后即可查看。您还可以将结果保存到Gulab项目中，上传参考图片，查看信用余额和使用情况，并在gulab.ai上打开您的作品进行编辑。生成内容将消耗您Gulab账户中的信用额度。

payload.name: Ava Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research short-form video references, manage brand media, draft campaign concepts, generate images, video and audio, and edit or export projects in Ava Studio. Sign in with Ava to choose permissions and a monthly credit budget. Actions use existing account credits and return usage information.
payload.longDescription:
在Ava Studio中研究短视频参考素材、管理品牌媒体资料、起草活动方案、生成图片/视频/音频内容，并进行项目编辑或导出。
通过Ava登录可设置权限和月度信用额度。
操作将消耗账户现有信用额度，并返回使用数据。

payload.name: SoeMind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SoeMind creates marketing content for small businesses: short videos, product images, voiceovers and music, organized inside your own brand projects. Connect your SoeMind account to generate content from ChatGPT, check the status of running jobs, browse recent outputs, and get links to finished files. You always see a generation's estimate and approve it before anything runs. Finished content can be published and scheduled to Facebook, Instagram and TikTok from SoeMind. Supports Southeast Asian languages including Burmese and Thai. Requires a SoeMind account.
payload.longDescription: SoeMind为小型企业创建营销内容：短视频、产品图片、配音和音乐，并整理在您自己的品牌项目中。连接您的SoeMind账户，通过ChatGPT生成内容，查看运行中任务的状态，浏览最新输出成果，并获取完成文件的链接。您始终能看到生成内容的预估效果，并在任何内容执行前进行审批。完成的营销内容可直接通过SoeMind发布并安排发布时间至Facebook、Instagram和TikTok。支持包括缅甸语和泰语在内的东南亚语言。需要SoeMind账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate short marketing videos, Generate product and brand images, Generate voiceovers and music, Estimate and approve generations before they run, List projects and recent outputs, Check connected social accounts

payload.name: Formatry
payload.description: 从照片和文案创建广告
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create campaign ad concepts from local product photos and brand copy, edit and preview them, and save verified raster files directly in your Codex workspace. Native OAuth connects your account.
payload.longDescription: 从本地产品照片和品牌文案创建活动广告概念，编辑并预览，将已验证的光栅文件直接保存到您的Codex工作区。原生OAuth可连接您的账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create ad images from your photos and text, Adapt designs for posts, stories and banners, Try new headlines, calls to action and colors, Preview changes to your saved designs

payload.name: PropertyPrompt
payload.description: 从平面图到带家具的3D模型
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PropertyPrompt turns a floor plan into a 3D model of a property that ChatGPT can build, furnish and change for you.

Share a floor plan or describe the rooms, with at least one real measurement. ChatGPT builds the walls, doors, windows and floors to scale in metres, then furnishes the rooms with real products, modelled from their published dimensions with a link to the retailer's page. A live viewer in the chat shows each change as it is made, and ChatGPT can render a view to check how a room looks.

Use it to plan a move, try furniture before you buy it, check whether a sofa fits or compare layouts. Every change is made against the property's current version and kept in its history, so you can ask ChatGPT to undo it.

For renters and property owners planning a space, and for interior designers and estate agents who model properties for clients.

You sign in with a PropertyPrompt account, and the app reaches only that account's properties. Properties are private. Only you can make one public, on propertyprom.pt; ChatGPT can never do it. Open a property on propertyprom.pt to walk through it in the browser or in VR.

Limitations: a model is only as accurate as the plans and measurements it is built from, and is not architectural or engineering advice. Product names, prices and links come from ChatGPT's research and can be out of date; the retailer's own page is what counts. PropertyPrompt does not sell products or take payments, and is not affiliated with the retailers shown. Accounts have a property limit and a fair use policy.
payload.longDescription:
PropertyPrompt能将平面图转化为ChatGPT可构建、布置并修改的3D房产模型。

上传平面图或描述房间信息，并提供至少一个实际尺寸。
ChatGPT会按米为单位精确构建墙体、门、窗和地板，然后通过链接跳转至零售商页面，用真实产品布置房间。
聊天中的实时查看器可展示每次修改效果，ChatGPT还能渲染视角检查房间效果。

可用于规划搬迁、购买前试摆家具、确认沙发尺寸或对比布局。
每次修改都基于房产当前版本并记录历史，您可要求ChatGPT撤销操作。

适用于计划空间的租户/房产所有者，以及为客户提供房产模型的室内设计师和房产经纪人。

您需使用PropertyPrompt账户登录，应用仅访问该账户的房产。
房产信息为私有内容。
只有您可将房产设为公开，地址为propertyprom.pt；ChatGPT无法自行公开。
在propertyprom.pt打开房产可在浏览器或VR中浏览。

限制说明：模型准确性取决于原始平面图和尺寸数据，不构成建筑或工程建议。
产品名称、价格和链接来自ChatGPT的调研可能已过时；以零售商页面信息为准。
PropertyPrompt不销售产品或处理支付，且与展示零售商无关联。
账户设有房产数量限制和合理使用政策。

payload.name: Adly
payload.description: 创建并发布社交媒体内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Adly is an AI marketing platform for small businesses and agencies. Tell ChatGPT what you want to promote and Adly designs the post, carousel, video or ad on your brand (your logo, colors, fonts and tone), writes the copy in Arabic or English, and publishes or schedules it to your Facebook Page, Instagram, LinkedIn profile and X account.

What you can do:
- Create single-post designs, tip carousels, product-photo ads, UGC-style and scene-based videos.
- Write and edit ad copy, then approve it in chat.
- Check what is ready, preview it, and ask for changes.
- Publish now or schedule for later, list upcoming posts and cancel one.
- Open the Adly content board from the sidebar to see your latest content and everything that is scheduled.

Limits to know: creating content counts toward your Adly usage limit. You need an Adly account to connect. Social accounts are connected once on getadly.com. Posts to X have no links, and X posting is not included in every Adly account. TikTok publishing is coming soon.
payload.longDescription:
Adly是面向小型企业和代理商的AI营销平台。告诉ChatGPT您想推广的内容，Adly将根据您的品牌（包括logo、颜色、字体和语气）设计帖子、轮播图、视频或广告，用阿拉伯语或英语撰写文案，并发布或预约发布到您的Facebook页面、Instagram、LinkedIn个人资料和X账号。

您可以：
- 创建单条帖子设计、小贴士轮播图、产品图片广告、用户生成内容风格及场景类视频。
- 撰写并编辑广告文案，通过聊天窗口进行审批。
- 查看待处理内容，预览后提出修改要求。
- 立即发布或预约后续发布，查看待发内容并取消某条帖子。
- 从侧边栏打开Adly内容看板，查看最新内容及所有预约内容。

需注意的限制：创建内容会消耗您的Adly使用配额。您需要Adly账户才能连接。社交账号需在getadly.com一次性连接。发往X平台的内容不含链接，X平台发帖功能并非所有Adly账户均支持。TikTok发布功能即将上线。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create designs, Create videos, Write ad copy, Publish posts, Schedule posts, Content board

payload.name: Etch Express
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Etch Express helps trophy, award, and engraving shops prepare production designs. Create and edit engraving jobs, recipient tables, plate layouts, and bed layouts; reuse saved templates; upload artwork and source documents; validate saved geometry; and export PDF or SVG ZIP files. Manage store inventory, view analytics, and update store and organization settings according to your account permissions.
payload.longDescription: Etch Express帮助奖杯、奖项和雕刻店准备生产设计。创建和编辑雕刻任务、收件人表格、板布局和床布局；复用已保存的模板；上传艺术作品和源文件；验证保存的几何图形；导出PDF或SVG压缩文件。根据账户权限管理店铺库存、查看分析数据，并更新店铺和组织设置。

payload.name: Designelier
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create coherent sets of 1–6 stylized icons or isolated spot illustrations from named subjects, a shared style and a color palette. Review the asset plan before generation, preview the results in chat, and download a ZIP with transparent full-canvas and cropped WebP plus self-contained SVG files. payload.name: Rawnd
payload.description: 在聊天中打开RAW格式照片
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rawnd opens camera RAW photos inside the conversation. ChatGPT reads JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF; a NEF, CR3, ARW or RAF file shows it nothing. Rawnd adds a panel where you drop the RAW file. The file is read on your device, inside the panel, and never uploaded: not to Rawnd, not to OpenAI.

What it does
- Shows the JPEG the camera stored inside the RAW file, in under a second, with the shooting data: camera, lens, shutter speed, aperture, ISO and focal length.
- Lets you keep that JPEG (right-click the preview, "Save image as…") or show it to ChatGPT with one click, stripped of its metadata, so you can talk about the photo.
- Offers eight hand-written looks: Dark film, Warm film, High-contrast B&W, Cool & muted, Golden hour, Matte, Crisp & vivid and Teal & orange. ChatGPT picks the one that matches what you describe, can adjust it within narrow bounds ("a bit less warm"), and shows a card that opens it in Rawnd's editor, in the browser.

Who it is for
Photographers with RAW files from Nikon, Canon, Sony, Fujifilm, Panasonic, Olympus, Pentax, Samsung, Leica, Phase One and other cameras, who want to see a RAW file, get a JPEG out of it or pick a look for it, without installing anything. Sixteen formats: CR2, CR3, CRW, NEF, NRW, ARW, SRF, SR2, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, PEF, SRW, IIQ and RAW.

Limits
- The panel shows the camera's own rendering, at the size the camera stored: full size on most Nikon and Canon bodies, 1920 × 1280 on Fujifilm. Developing the RAW itself (exposure, white balance) happens in Rawnd's editor.
- Camera RAW files only: it does not open JPEG, PNG or HEIC.
- A look opens in the editor; it is not applied inside the conversation.
- One file at a time.

Privacy
Rawnd's server receives only the tool arguments, a look's name and slider values, and counts one row per call: the tool and the assistant. No account, no sign-in, no photo.
payload.longDescription:
Rawnd 可在对话中打开相机 RAW 格式照片。
ChatGPT 可以读取 JPEG、PNG、WebP 和 GIF 格式；但遇到 NEF、CR3、ARW 或 RAF 文件时则无法处理。
Rawnd 添加了一个文件面板用于放置 RAW 文件。
文件在您的设备上读取，位于面板内，且永远不会上传：既不会上传至 Rawnd，也不会上传至 OpenAI。

功能说明
- 在一秒内显示 RAW 文件中相机存储的 JPEG 图像，并附带拍摄数据：相机型号、镜头、快门速度、光圈、ISO 和焦距。
- 允许您保存该 JPEG 图像（右键预览图，选择「另存为」）或通过单击将图像发送给 ChatGPT，图像会自动去除元数据，方便您讨论照片内容。
- 提供八种手写风格：暗调胶片、暖调胶片、高对比度黑白、冷调柔和、黄金时刻、哑光、鲜明生动和青橙色调。
ChatGPT 会根据您描述的内容选择匹配的风格，可在狭窄范围内调整（「稍微冷一点」），并显示一张可点击的卡片，直接在浏览器中打开 Rawnd 编辑器。

适用人群
适用于使用尼康、佳能、索尼、富士、松下、奥林巴斯、宾得、三星、徕卡、Phase One 等相机拍摄 RAW 格式文件的摄影师，无需安装任何软件即可查看 RAW 文件、导出 JPEG 或为照片选择风格。
支持十六种格式：CR2、CR3、CRW、NEF、NRW、ARW、SRF、SR2、RAF、DNG、RW2、ORF、PEF、SRW、IIQ 和 RAW。

使用限制
- 面板仅显示相机原生渲染效果，尺寸为相机存储的原始尺寸：大多数尼康和佳能设备为全尺寸，富士设备为 1920 × 1280。
RAW 文件的处理（曝光、白平衡）需在 Rawnd 编辑器中完成。
- 仅支持相机 RAW 格式文件：不支持 JPEG、PNG 或 HEIC 格式。
- 风格效果仅在编辑器中打开，不会直接应用在对话中。
- 每次仅处理一个文件。

隐私政策
Rawnd 服务器仅接收工具参数、风格名称和滑块值，并按每次调用统计一行：工具和助手各占一行。
无需账户、无需登录、不存储任何照片。

payload.name: Beatwise Metronome

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Beatwise Metronome helps musicians plan tempo practice with an online metronome, tap tempo and a bpm counter in the chat. Set a 120 bpm metronome, choose accents and subdivisions, or build a bar-based tempo ramp. Use the beat row with sound or for silent practice.

The tempo calculator converts bpm to ms and rhythmic cycle hertz for whole through sixty-fourth notes, including dotted notes and triplets. Use it as a delay time calculator, compare reverb pre-delay suggestions, reverse a known note duration into beats per minute, or calculate bar and song length. BPM means quarter notes per minute. Italian tempo markings are approximate ranges that can overlap.

Plan a metronome for practice with a start tempo, target tempo, a BPM or percent step and minutes per stage. Preview the ladder and download it as CSV.

Limits: 20–400 quarter-note BPM, 1–16 beats per bar, 1000 ramp stages and 200 practice stages. Numeric inputs accept up to three decimal places. The widget runs only while it is on the screen. Audio timing depends on the device. No recording and no pitch detection.
payload.longDescription:
Beatwise Metronome通过聊天窗口内的在线节拍器、敲击节拍功能和BPM计数器，帮助音乐家规划节奏练习。设置120 BPM节拍器，选择重音和细分，或构建基于小节的节奏渐变。使用节拍行进行有声练习或无声练习。

节拍计算器可将BPM转换为毫秒和节奏周期赫兹，支持从全音符到六十四分音符的所有音符类型，包括附点音符和三连音。可用作延迟时间计算器，对比混响预延迟建议，将已知音符时值反推为每分钟节拍数，或计算小节和歌曲长度。BPM表示每分钟四分音符数量。意大利速度标记为近似范围值，可能存在重叠。

通过起始节拍、目标节拍、BPM或百分比步长和每阶段分钟数，规划练习用节拍器。预览渐变效果并以CSV格式下载。

限制条件：四分音符BPM范围20–400，每小节1–16拍，最多1000级渐变阶段和200级练习阶段。数值输入支持最多三位小数。插件仅在屏幕显示时运行。音频定时依赖设备性能。不支持录音和音高检测。

payload.name: Rephrasy
payload.description: 让AI草稿听起来更像人类写作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rephrasy is a writing and editing assistant for text you drafted with AI. Share a draft and Rephrasy rewrites it into natural, human-sounding prose: it varies sentence rhythm, trims stock phrasing and filler, and aims to keep your meaning, facts, and figures, with a short report of what changed.

Tell Rephrasy what the text is for (blog, marketing, SEO, report, technical, or general) and it picks a suitable rewriting engine, or choose the engine and tone yourself. The output language can be set or detected automatically.

Before you publish, check a draft's AI-likelihood score to see which passages read as machine-written, and get a readability score to judge how easy the text is to follow. Rephrasy Studio opens an editor panel in the conversation so you can review, adjust, and copy the result.

Made for marketers, content teams, writers, and professionals who use AI for first drafts and want the final copy to sound like them.

Limitations: requires a Rephrasy account (you can create one when you connect). Texts up to 12,000 characters per request. AI-likelihood scores are statistical estimates, not proof of authorship. Do not use Rephrasy to misrepresent authorship where original, unassisted work is required.
payload.longDescription:
Rephrasy是专为AI撰写文本设计的写作与编辑助手。分享一份草稿，Rephrasy会将其重写为自然、贴近人类写作的文本：通过调整句子节奏、删减陈词滥调和填充内容，同时保留您的原意、事实和数据，并附上修改说明报告。

告知Rephrasy文本用途（博客、营销、SEO、报告、技术类或通用场景），它将自动选择合适的重写引擎，或由您自行选择引擎和语气。输出语言可手动设置或自动识别。

发布前可检查稿件的AI可能性分数，查看哪些段落呈现机器写作特征，并获取可读性分数判断文本易读程度。Rephrasy Studio会在对话中打开编辑面板，方便您审阅、调整并复制结果。

专为营销人员、内容团队、作家及需要AI完成初稿但希望终稿呈现个人风格的专业人士设计。

限制条件：需拥有Rephrasy账户（连接时可创建）。单次请求文本上限为12,000字符。AI可能性分数为统计估算结果，非作者身份证明。在需要原始未协助作品的场景中，请勿使用Rephrasy进行作者身份误导。

payload.name: TapNow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TapNow turns a brief, a product photo or a slide outline into finished visuals without leaving the conversation: hero images, short videos, e-commerce product shot sets and consistent deck illustrations. Every result lands in a TapNow canvas project you can open and keep editing, and you can search your TapNow asset library and save new work back to it.

- Short videos: turn a description, or a still image, into a 5 or 10 second clip. A quick draft comes first so you can check the direction.
- Product shots: from one product photo, create white-background, lifestyle, multi-angle and detail shots sized for major marketplaces.
- Deck visuals: illustrate up to 12 slides or sections in one consistent style, with room left for your text.
- Asset library: find images in your TapNow library, bring a public image into TapNow, and save results to a folder.

Account
TapNow requires a TapNow account. The first time you use it, ChatGPT asks you to sign in to TapNow and approve access. ChatGPT checks with you before starting a video, since videos take a few minutes to render.
payload.longDescription:
TapNow无需离开对话界面即可将简要说明、产品照片或幻灯片大纲转化为完整视觉素材：主视觉图、短视频、电商产品拍摄套装以及统一风格的演示文稿插图。所有生成结果都会保存到您可以打开并继续编辑的TapNow画布项目中，您还可以搜索TapNow资产库并把新作品保存至对应文件夹。

payload.name: PersonalizedComics

PersonalizedComics turns the people in your photos into the stars of a short comic. Attach a photo of each person (up to four), say what should happen and what it is for, and the plugin writes a complete two-page story and draws it: first the cast, so you can check that everyone looks like themselves and redraw anyone who does not, then a cover, the two story pages and a back cover. payload.name: Website Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Website Maker helps you plan, write, build and improve websites by chat. Describe your business and it creates a complete multi-page site with real copy and responsive code, or any single page you need.

What you can do:
- Build a complete website: get every page written and coded from one description, or start from an industry starter for restaurants, clinics, salons, trades, coaches and more.
- Write conversion-focused copy: homepage, about, services, pricing, contact, FAQ, landing and portfolio pages with clear headlines and calls to action.
- Check any page: paste its HTML or text to get scores for SEO, content, conversion, accessibility and technical basics, with a prioritized list of fixes.
- Improve your SEO: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, local SEO, structured data and blog plans.
- Edit and export code: change existing pages from plain-English instructions, or convert them to Tailwind CSS, React, Next.js, Vue, Bootstrap or WordPress.
- Grow and launch: lead forms, booking pages, online stores, membership sites, starter legal pages, brand kits, domain name ideas and a launch checklist.
- Get a build link: turn your plan into a link that opens an online website builder with your site brief already filled in.

The build link opens an online website builder with your brief and includes the plugin creator's affiliate code. Website Maker is an independent plugin and is not sponsored or endorsed by that builder.

Limitations: Website Maker writes plans, copy and code in the conversation. It does not host or publish websites, register domains or connect to your website's dashboard. Legal pages are starter drafts, not legal advice. Details it cannot know about your business, such as prices, reviews and contact details, are marked for you to confirm or fill in.

Every response ends with a short footer that includes an affiliate link and an affiliate disclosure.
payload.longDescription:
Website Maker通过聊天帮助您规划、撰写、构建和优化网站。描述您的业务，它将创建包含真实文案和响应式代码的完整多页面网站，或您需要的任何单页网站。

- 优化SEO：标题标签、元描述、标题层级、本地SEO、结构化数据和博客计划。
- 编辑并导出代码：通过纯文本指令修改现有页面，或将其转换为Tailwind CSS、React、Next.js、Vue、Bootstrap或WordPress格式。
- 扩展与发布：创建线索表单、预订页面、在线商店、会员网站、基础法律页面、品牌工具包、域名建议和发布检查清单。
- 获取构建链接：将您的方案转化为链接，打开在线网站构建器并自动填充您的网站简报。

适用人群：小型企业主、自由职业者、创作者、顾问、营销人员以及无需雇佣机构即可建立网站的任何人。

工具使用说明：页面检查器仅分析您在对话中分享的HTML或文本。
它不会打开网址，您发送的页面和简报不会被存储。
构建链接会打开在线网站构建器并加载您的简报，包含插件创作者的联盟代码。
Website Maker是独立插件，未获得该构建器的赞助或认可。

限制条件：Website Maker在对话中生成方案、文案和代码。
它不托管或发布网站、注册域名或连接到您的网站仪表盘。
法律页面仅为起步草案，非法律建议。

每个回复结尾均包含包含联盟链接和联盟披露的简短页脚。

payload.name: Linepace Teleprompter
