Linepace Teleprompter is for people who record video or give a speech. Plan and read a speech or video script in a live teleprompter inside the conversation. Linepace calculates spoken-word timing, adds [PAUSE] cue time, shows section timing, and helps plan words for a target duration. The reader has a fixed reading line, elapsed and remaining time, mirror mode, font controls, fullscreen, and reduced-motion step controls.

Use it for a presentation, video script, wedding toast, classroom talk, product demo, or practice run. Choose slow (110), conversational (130), presentation (150), fast (170), or a whole number from 60 to 300 words per minute.

Numeric pause cues accept whole seconds from 1 to 86,400 per cue. Limitations: no camera or recording. The widget runs only while it is on screen, and speaking speed differs by person.
payload.longDescription:
Linepace Teleprompter适用于录制视频或进行演讲的人群。在对话中内置实时提词器，可规划并阅读演讲稿或视频剧本。Linepace会计算口语时间，添加[PAUSE]提示时间，显示章节时间，并帮助规划目标时长的用词量。阅读器具备固定阅读行、已用时间和剩余时间显示、镜像模式、字体控制、全屏显示以及减少运动步进控制功能。

可用于演示、视频剧本、婚礼致辞、课堂演讲、产品演示或练习演练。可选择每分钟60到300字的任意整数速度，包括慢速（110）、日常对话（130）、演示（150）、快速（170）等选项。

数字暂停提示支持每条1到86,400秒的整数秒数。限制条件：不支持摄像头或录制功能。该小部件仅在屏幕显示时运行，且个人语速存在差异。

payload.name: One4Wall
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
One4Wall brings a catalog of original phone wallpapers into ChatGPT. Describe what you want, such as a mood, a subject or a color, and ChatGPT shows matching wallpapers as a gallery. Tap one to see it large, download it in full resolution, or open it on one4wall.app.

Things you can ask:
- Find a cozy rainy city wallpaper for my phone
- Show me pastel flower wallpapers
- I want a dark minimal mountain lock screen
- Something blue and calm with the ocean

Every wallpaper is made by One4Studio for portrait phone screens. The gallery shows up to eight results at a time; ask again with different words to see more.
payload.longDescription:
One4Wall将原创手机壁纸目录带入ChatGPT。描述您想要的风格、主题或颜色，ChatGPT会以画廊形式展示匹配的壁纸。点击任意一张可查看大图、以原分辨率下载，或在one4wall.app上打开。

您可以询问的内容包括：
- 为我的手机寻找一张温馨的雨中城市壁纸
- 展示给我粉色花朵壁纸
- 我想要暗色系极简山景锁屏
- 一些蓝色系且充满海洋元素的宁静画面

所有壁纸均由One4Studio专为竖屏手机屏幕设计。每次画廊最多显示八张结果；更换关键词再次提问可查看更多。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search wallpapers by mood, subject or color, Preview matching wallpapers in a gallery, Download full-resolution phone wallpapers

payload.name: Buzzy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create images, videos, branded ads, and short films with Buzzy in ChatGPT. Start with an idea, a product link, or a reference image, choose a creative workflow, and refine the result through conversation.

With Buzzy, you can:

• Generate images and videos from text or a reference image, video, or audio file. Choose a model, then use a resolution, aspect ratio, and duration that model supports.

• Upload a local image, video, or audio file and use the returned link as a reference for the next generation.

• Make a UGC-style product ad from a product page, product image, or product description, including a showcase, unboxing, or creator-style review.

• Produce a TVC or brand commercial from a product link, image, or description, with a storyboard, character sheets, clips, and music.

• Create a single cinematic live-action shot, or a short 3D rendered clip, from a brief and an optional reference.

• Build a longer live-action micro-film or animated story, with a script, character sheets, scene previews, clips, and music.

• Pick a style, background, music track, or character image when a workflow asks you to choose one.

Describe what you want to make, review the results in chat, and continue from the same project.

Connect your Buzzy account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中使用Buzzy创建图片、视频、品牌广告和短片。从一个想法、产品链接或参考图片开始，选择创意工作流程，并通过对话逐步优化结果。

使用Buzzy，您可以：

• 通过文本或参考图片、视频、音频文件生成图片和视频。选择支持所需分辨率、宽高比和时长的模型。

• 上传本地图片、视频或音频文件，并使用返回的链接作为下一次生成的参考。

• 从产品页面、产品图片或产品描述制作UGC风格的产品广告，包含展示、开箱视频或创作者风格评测。

• 通过产品链接、图片或描述制作电视广告或品牌宣传片，包含分镜脚本、角色设定、片段和背景音乐。

• 根据简报和可选参考，创建单个电影级实拍镜头或短时长3D渲染片段。

• 创建更长的实拍短片或动画故事，包含剧本、角色资料、场景预览、片段和音乐。

• 当工作流程要求选择时，可自行挑选风格、背景、音乐轨道或角色图像。

• 描述你想制作的内容，在聊天中查看结果，并从同一项目继续操作。

• 连接你的Buzzy账户以开始使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate images and videos, Make product and brand ads, Create cinematic and 3D clips, Produce stories

payload.name: CILA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
**Track what’s trending across Instagram + TikTok, spot outliers and get ideas for content ideation**

CILA brings your Instagram + TikTok content research into ChatGPT and Codex. Track your niche, spot outliers and turn what's working into your next content idea.

What you can do:

- Check your tracked lists: Pull the latest posts from the competitors and creators you track in CILA, and find the outliers across your niche.
- Search by topic: Find what's taking off on Instagram + TikTok for any topic.
- Save winning ideas: Create folders, save posts into them and pull them back up when you're planning content.
payload.longDescription:
跟踪Instagram和TikTok上的热门趋势，发现独特内容并获取创意灵感

CILA将您的Instagram和TikTok内容研究整合到ChatGPT和Codex中。跟踪您的细分领域，发现独特内容，并将有效的内容转化为下一个创意

您可以执行以下操作：

- 查看跟踪列表：获取CILA中您关注的竞争对手和创作者的最新帖子，在细分领域中发现独特内容
- 按主题搜索：查找任何主题在Instagram和TikTok上的热门内容
- 保存成功创意：创建文件夹，保存优质帖子并在规划内容时随时调取

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search content, Analyse tracked competitors, Read video transcripts, Organise saved content

payload.name: Your Color Palette
payload.description: 从自拍中识别色彩季节
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your color season from one selfie. Your Color Palette measures your skin, eyes and hair on your device, inside the chat. It shows your most likely season out of 12, the runner-up, and how confident the reading is. You see your face on your best and your worst palette, and three colors from your palette.

Your photo is measured on your device. We and ChatGPT never see it.
payload.longDescription:
通过一张自拍即可找到您的色彩季节。
Your Color Palette 通过设备在聊天内对您的皮肤、眼睛和头发进行分析。
它会显示您最可能对应的12种色彩季节中的最佳季节、次佳季节，以及该分析结果的可信度。
您可以看到自己在最佳和最不匹配色系中的面部效果，并获取色系中的三种颜色。

您的照片仅在设备上进行分析。
我们和 ChatGPT 永远不会查看。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find your color season from a selfie, See your best and worst palette on your face

payload.name: PrintMap
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PrintMap builds a ready-to-edit map poster from a sentence. Ask for any city, town, mountain or country, a style (25 to choose from — minimalist, vintage, nautical, blueprint, satellite, topographic and more), a paper size and a caption, and PrintMap shows a live preview of the real map in the chat. The map is drawn from OpenStreetMap data, so streets, rivers and coastlines are accurate, not invented.

One click opens the printm.app editor with everything already set up: fine-tune colours, add markers, a route or a GPX track, then download a high-resolution PNG, a vector SVG or PDF, a 3D-printable terrain model or a rotating video.

Great for wedding and anniversary gifts, hometown and travel posters, and hiking or running route keepsakes.
payload.longDescription:
PrintMap 通过一句话生成可编辑的海报地图。输入任何城市、城镇、山脉或国家，选择一种风格（25种可选——极简、复古、航海、蓝图、卫星、地形等），指定纸张尺寸和标题，PrintMap 即在聊天中显示实时预览的实景地图。地图数据来源于 OpenStreetMap，因此道路、河流和海岸线都准确无误，而非虚构的。

点击一下即可打开 printm.app 编辑器，所有内容已预先配置：调整颜色、添加标记、路线或 GPX 轨迹，然后下载高分辨率 PNG、矢量 SVG 或 PDF、可3D打印的地形模型或旋转视频。

非常适合婚礼和纪念日礼物、家乡和旅行海报，以及徒步或跑步路线纪念品。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create a map poster of any place on Earth, Country-silhouette posters, 25 map styles, custom captions and paper sizes, Live poster preview in the chat, Print-ready PNG, SVG and PDF download in the editor

payload.name: HospitalityLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AI photo editing for property listing images, from phone snaps or existing photos.

Plan a clear set of phone photos, improve a property image you already have, and compare the original with the result. Adjust the style, look, outdoor season, indoor seasonal decoration and cleanup for each photo. Choose the company watermark and TV/fireplace options available in your workspace. Saved logos, reference images and their appearance are managed on the website. Organize photos into property projects using your connected HospitalityLens account.

For property managers, rental hosts, hotels, agents, landlords and homeowners. Portfolio size never limits access. The ChatGPT studio processes one photo at a time; bulk workflows remain on the HospitalityLens website.

Photo processing uses entitlements already available in your account. JPEG, PNG and WebP are supported, up to 20 MB. Results depend on the source photo; retain the real property's layout, fixtures, views and permanent features.
payload.longDescription:
AI照片编辑服务，适用于房产挂牌图片，无论是手机拍摄的照片还是现有图片。

规划一组清晰的手机照片，优化您已有的房产图片，并对比原始图片与处理后的结果。
调整每张照片的风格、外观、户外季节、室内季节性装饰和清洁度。
选择工作区中提供的公司水印和电视/壁炉选项。
在网站上管理保存的logo、参考图片及其显示样式。
通过连接的HospitalityLens账户将照片整理为房产项目。

适用于物业经理、租赁房东、酒店、经纪人、房东和房主。
无论作品集规模大小，均可访问全部功能。
ChatGPT工作室每次仅处理一张照片；批量处理流程仍需在HospitalityLens网站完成。

照片处理使用账户中已有的权限。
支持JPEG、PNG和WebP格式，单个文件不超过20MB。
处理结果取决于源图质量，将保留房产的真实布局、固定装置、景观和永久性特征。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Plan property photos, Enhance property photos, Compare results, Organize property projects

payload.name: Runchat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Runchat is a node-based canvas for design workflows used by architects, designers and computational designers. Connect your Runchat account to build, edit and run workflows from ChatGPT: chain language models, design-visualisation models and code into a reusable pipeline, then publish it as a tool or a hosted page.

With the Runchat plugin running in Rhino, Grasshopper or Blender, ChatGPT can also read your open model, run scripts in it, build Grasshopper definitions and capture the viewport to check its work. With the ClipChat desktop app, it can edit your screen recordings into finished videos.

Requires a Runchat account. Desktop tools only work while the matching Runchat plugin or ClipChat app is open and signed in to the same account.
payload.longDescription:
Runchat是建筑师、设计师和计算设计师用于设计工作流程的基于节点的画布。将您的Runchat账户连接起来，从ChatGPT构建、编辑并运行工作流程：将语言模型、设计可视化模型和代码串联成可重用的流程，然后发布为工具或托管页面。

在Rhino、Grasshopper或Blender中运行Runchat插件时，ChatGPT还可以读取您的打开模型，在其中运行脚本，构建Grasshopper定义并捕获视图窗口以检查其工作成果。通过ClipChat桌面应用，它可以将您的屏幕录制编辑成完成的视频。

需要Runchat账户。桌面工具仅在匹配的Runchat插件或ClipChat应用打开且登录同一账户时才能使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Build and edit design workflows, Run workflows and return their outputs, Publish workflows as tools and pages, Script Rhino and Blender, Build Grasshopper definitions, Edit ClipChat screen recordings

payload.name: Revid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Revid turns an idea into a finished short-form video without leaving the chat. Give it a prompt, a script, an article URL, an audio file, or a music track, and Revid writes the script, generates the visuals, adds a voiceover and captions, and renders a vertical video ready for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. You can estimate the credit cost before rendering, check render progress, export the MP4, and schedule or publish the video to your connected social accounts. Revid also searches viral short-form videos across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit, Threads, and LinkedIn so you can study what is working before you create. Requires a Revid account with an active plan; renders consume credits from your Revid account.
payload.longDescription: Revid无需离开聊天界面即可将创意转化为完整的短视频。提供提示、脚本、文章链接、音频文件或音乐轨道，Revid将撰写脚本、生成视觉内容、添加配音和字幕，并渲染适合TikTok、Reels和Shorts的竖版视频。您可在渲染前预估信用消耗，查看渲染进度，导出MP4文件，并安排或发布视频至已连接的社交账号。Revid还支持跨平台搜索YouTube、TikTok、Instagram、X、Reddit、Threads和LinkedIn的病毒式传播短视频，助您在创作前分析成功要素。需要拥有有效计划的Revid账户，渲染将消耗账户积分。
